title: The Predator’s Niche
narrativeSpine: Trust supports cooperation and exploitation; individual, institutional and artificial patterns require different evidence and mechanisms of correction.
firstSceneDraft: The Predator's Niche examines predation that succeeds by appearing to cooperate.
Its nonfiction inquiry treats trust as both a social achievement and an exploitable resource.
The scope connects psychopathic traits, organizational incentives, and artificial agents.
The book distinguishes research, inference, and speculation rather than treating them as interchangeable evidence.
visualActionProposal: A cooperative workshop passes real materials through several hands; a hidden diversion changes what reaches the recipient, then segmented departmental views are physically reconnected.
